description:
Discover the truth behind the Great Fire of London and whether a simple baker really caused the 1666 disaster. Beyond the popular myth, explore how wooden houses, delayed political decisions, and changing winds shaped the catastrophe.

Learn how officials hesitated to act, how gunpowder eventually stopped the flames, and how London rose again from the ashes.
